issues.description: Resource IDs are interpolated into URL paths without percent-encoding, allowing slash/colon/path manipulation.
Transient httpx transport exceptions and timeouts are not retried or wrapped in typed client errors.
Retry-After only supports numeric seconds and ignores valid HTTP-date Retry-After headers.
Successful responses are parsed with unchecked json/key access, so malformed API responses raise raw JSONDecodeError/KeyError.
BatchItemResult and ReviewResult do not validate enum/status values or result consistency when parsing API data.
Dev tooling only installs pytest; there is no formatter, linter, or type checker configuration for a typed client library.
Tests import helper classes from conftest.py directly instead of a normal helper module.
